dateline: Bamako / Kidal / Ménaka / Kompienbiga / Barsalogho / Titao / Goubré — 2012–Present
heroHeadline: ~30 Massacred at Kompienbiga Eid Market; ICRC Convoy Ambushed Near Barsalogho; Bamako Siege Day 33 as Post-Truce Window Holds
heroSubtitle: Burkina Faso suffered its fifth major JNIM atrocity of May 2026 as gunmen on motorcycles massacred approximately 30 civilians at the Kompienbiga livestock market (Est Region) on May 31 — the second day of Eid al-Adha. The same day marks 33 days since JNIM declared a 'total siege' of Bamako. On May 29–30, JNIM attacked an ICRC-affiliated aid convoy returning from Foube refugee camp near Barsalogho (Sanmatenga Province), killing at least 13 including an ICRC ambulance driver and nurse in a grave breach of international humanitarian law. On May 29, the Burkinabè junta shut Ouagadougou's Grand Mosque and detained ~100 protesters after arresting respected Islamic scholar Imam Mohamed Kindo for criticizing a proposed religious freedoms law — a politically risky action during Eid that risks alienating the senior Islamic clerical class historically resistant to JNIM. Three key ongoing fronts: (1) BAMAKO BLOCKADE (Day 33): Post-Eid window ongoing with no new JNIM escalation confirmed in the 72-hour post-Eid period; 3 of 6 supply corridors remain disrupted (Amnesty International, May 15); WFP suspended ($620M gap); IRC emergency response active; FAO projects 52.8M at acute food insecurity June–August. US Embassy security alert expired May 31. (2) KIDAL AERIAL CAMPAIGN (ongoing): FAMa/Africa Corps continue striking FLA/JNIM-held Kidal; no ground-offensive capacity confirmed. (3) BURKINA FASO COLLAPSE: JNIM's Eid-period operations span Loroum (15+ killed, May 29), Barsalogho ICRC convoy (13+ killed, May 30), and Kompienbiga market (~30 killed, May 31) — demonstrating undiminished multi-district operational tempo across Burkina Faso's Nord, Centre-Nord, and Est regions simultaneously. Total confirmed JNIM-attributed major atrocity deaths in Burkina Faso in May 2026: approximately 300+.
